# Target

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Terminology](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Target)*

A target is the creature or object targeted by an attack roll, forced to make a [saving throw](../D20-Tests/Saving-Throw.md) by an effect, or selected to receive the effects of a spell or another phenomenon.
